root_cause: Escape key closes the dropdown menu but does not return focus to the toggle button, leaving focus on the document body.
repair_strategy: Modify the _completeHide method in dropdown.js to restore focus to the toggle element after hiding the menu.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape will close the invoice actions menu and move focus back to the 'Invoice actions' toggle button, ensuring a logical focus order for keyboard users.
functional_risks: If the toggle button becomes disabled or removed from the DOM before hide() is called, calling focus() could throw or fail silently.
Setting focus after hiding may interfere with custom handlers that expect focus to remain elsewhere after a dismissal.
verification_requirements: After pressing Escape, the attribute aria-expanded on #actions-toggle must be 'false'.
After pressing Escape, the focused element must be #actions-toggle.
The dropdown menu must not be visible (no 'show' class on #actions-menu).
Other dismissal methods (click outside, Tab navigation) should continue to work as expected.
